jobs.description:
About Chr. Olesen Group

Chr. Olesen Group is a leading international distribution company specializing in vitamins, minerals, and active pharmaceutical ingredients for the feed, food, pharma, and technical industries. With products sourced primarily from Asia, we proudly serve esteemed customers worldwide. As a family-owned business led by the 4th and 5th generations, we combine significant turnover with a close-knit team, making our roles both challenging and rewarding. Discover more about our fascinating history at www.chr-olesen.dk.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Finance Manager to join our headquarters in Gentofte, Denmark.

Reporting directly to the CFO, you will play a key role in Group Finance, acting as the day-to-day link between headquarters and our overseas subsidiaries.

The position combines financial controlling, reporting, coordination of budgeting and closing activities, and financial analysis with the implementation and follow-up of Group finance standards, procedures, and ad hoc projects.

Working closely with the CFO and local finance teams, you will help integrate Group finance standards and procedures into daily operations in HQ, and overseas, and monitor adherence, and coordinate improvements.

Key Responsibilities

• Act as the day-to-day finance link between HQ and the overseas (LATAM. US and Turkey), teams, facilitating communication, coordination, and follow-up in partnership with local finance colleagues and regional finance leadership.

• Coordinate HQ requirements for budgeting, forecasting, and ongoing financial follow-up with local finance teams, reviewing inputs for consistency with Group standards.

• Review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting from local teams and coordinate follow-up to ensure accuracy, consistency, and alignment with Group reporting requirements.

• Coordinate Group closing requirements and timelines with local finance teams and support the resolution of issues during month-end and year-end closing.

• Work closely with regional finance leadership, local colleagues, external accountants, and other relevant stakeholders to resolve day-to-day finance issues and escalate unresolved matters to the CFO.

• Act as a key financial sparring partner to the CFO and provide management with financial insights and analysis to support decision-making.

• Coordinate the implementation and integration of Group finance standards, procedures, and internal controls in LATAM and the US, monitor adherence, and follow up on corrective actions with local teams.

• Develop and maintain Group finance standards.

• Implementation and maintenance of group closing system.

• Work hands-on in Microsoft Business Central and contribute to the effective use and development of the system across the finance function.

• Take ownership of a broad range of ad hoc financial analyses, projects, and tasks arising as the Group and its international activities develop.

Key Skills for Success

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. An HD in Accounting/Finance or a relevant Master’s degree is also highly valued.

• Solid experience within financial controlling, accounting, finance, or a similar role, preferably within an international organization.

• Strong experience with budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, month-end and year-end closing, and financial analysis.

• Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial processes, and internal controls, with the ability to translate Group standards and procedures into consistent day-to-day practices.

• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Business Central.

• Ability to take ownership, work independently, and manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

• A proactive and pragmatic approach, with the flexibility to handle both recurring responsibilities and a broad range of ad hoc assignments.

• Experience in Microsoft Excel and Power BI.

• Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

Why Chr. Olesen Group?

• Global Exposure: Work with a diverse team across multiple countries and gain invaluable international experience.

• Career Growth: We believe in nurturing talent and providing opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

• Innovative Environment: Be part of a forward-thinking company that leverages cutting-edge technology and innovative solutions.

Are You Our New Colleague?

If you are a proactive and analytical finance professional who enjoys taking ownership, working internationally, and being close to the business, we would love to hear from you. Submit your application here.

Application deadline:

10. December 2026

jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in Exoplanet Science - Discovery and Characterization of Small Planets - DTU Space
jobs.description:
The Exoplanet Group at DTU Space, Technical University of Denmark, invites applications for a three-year PhD scholarship exoplanet science. Our group focuses on the discovery and characterization of small planets, from rocky worlds to super-Earths and sub-Neptunes. We combine observations, data analysis, modeling, and instrument development to understand the properties and diversity of these planets and the processes that shape their evolution.

Our research has two particularly active areas. In atmospheric characterization, we study the atmospheres of small exoplanets using observations from both space- and ground-based observatories, aiming to understand their composition, evolution, and retention. Much of our current research draws on the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), for which our group has led several successful observing programs (GO 2420, GO 3730, and GO 7675), alongside our involvement in numerous international collaborations, including involvement in ESA's Ariel Mission (Buchhave co-PI).

In extreme-precision radial velocity (EPRV) research, we work toward detecting and measuring low-mass planets, including through the Second Earth Spectrograph (2ES; PI: Buchhave; www.2es.dk). 2ES is a next-generation spectrograph under development for the MPG/ESO 2.2-m Telescope at La Silla, Chile, designed to search for temperate Earth-mass planets around bright southern solar-type stars. The project spans instrumentation, data analysis, stellar activity, and the preparation for commissioning and early science.

Our aim is to recruit a researcher whose scientific interests and expertise complement the group's work. The successful candidate will be free to pursue the questions in exoplanet science that they find most compelling, whether these connect directly to our current projects or bring related perspectives and methods to the group.

We consider an open and cooperative research atmosphere to be extremely important. Group members take an interest in one another's science, exchange ideas, and explore opportunities to work together. We hope to welcome a colleague who enjoys participating in such an environment while developing their own independent research.

You will join Prof. Lars A. Buchhave and Assistant Prof. Alexander Rathcke, and the growing Exoplanet Group at DTU Space (www.exoplanets.dk), located in the greater Copenhagen area. The group has access to data from world-class observatories, including JWST, precision RV spectrographs, and ESO facilities, and collaborates widely with researchers abroad.

Responsibilities and qualifications
We expect the successful candidate to develop and carry out original, independent research that complements the group's scientific interests. The specific direction will be shaped by the candidate's own interests and expertise. Possible research topics include:

 * Characterizing exoplanet atmospheres through transmission or emission spectroscopy, atmospheric retrievals and modeling, JWST data analysis, or studies of stellar contamination.

 * Detecting and characterizing low-mass planets through precision radial velocities, including RV data analysis, stellar activity mitigation, spectroscopic pipeline development, or 2ES instrumentation.

 * Pursuing other closely related observational, theoretical, or computational questions that complement the group's research on exoplanets.

We are seeking a talented and highly motivated student to work at the cutting edge of the rapidly moving research field of exoplanets. Applicants with previous experience in the mentioned areas of research are especially encouraged to apply, and we particularly value scientific initiative and strong analytical skills. Flexibility and self-motivation are desired skills, and the Exoplanet Group encourages a vibrant collaborative work environment, where collaboration with other group members is highly encouraged. In your application, we encourage you to describe how you can complement the group's scientific activities.

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures

The period of employment is 3 years. The starting date is flexible but would ideally commence in Q3-Q4 of 2027.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information 
Further information and inquiries about the position can be made to Prof. Lars A. Buchhave (buchhave@space.dtu.dk) or Dr. Alexander Rathcke (rathcke@space.dtu.dk).

You can read more about the Exoplanet Group at www.exoplanets.dk and the DTU Space institute at www.space.dtu.dk. 

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 22 January 2027 (23:59 Danish time).

Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
• Research statement describing your previous work and thoughts and ideas for future research (max 3 pages)
Shortlisted candidates will be asked to provide 2-3 reference letters to be emailed at a later date.

You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. 

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

About DTU Space
The DTU Space Institute has about 250 employees and is located in the greater Copenhagen area at the Lyngby Campus of the Technical University of Denmark. We link natural science closely with the development of new technology. DTU Space is involved in the full life cycle of space activities, including concept and design, construction and prototyping, calibration and validation, implementation and operations, data analysis, processing, dissemination, and applications, leading to new instruments and applications. With the specialised and refined technology available, we are getting more and more answers and further insight about the Earth and the universe surrounding us. We contribute to about 200 scientific publications a year.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.occupation: Process Engineer for advanced process solutions
jobs.description:
Do you want to develop technical process solutions for customers across the world and play a key role in transforming customer requirements into competitive and reliable industrial systems? Then this could be your next position.

On behalf of Simatek A/S, we are looking for a Process Engineer who will become a central technical resource in the company's Process & Proposal team and contribute to the continued development of customer-specific process solutions for industries worldwide.

About Simatek

Simatek A/S is an international engineering company specializing in air filtration, pneumatic conveying, dust handling, and process solutions for industries such as food, feed, grain, recycling, minerals, and industrial manufacturing. The company designs and delivers customized systems that help customers improve operational efficiency, product quality, environmental performance, and workplace safety. From its headquarters in Albertslund in Denmark, Simatek serves customers around the world and combines strong engineering expertise with a flexible and customer-oriented approach.

The position

As Process & Application Engineer, you will become part of Simatek's international Process & Proposal team with colleagues in both Denmark and India. Focusing primarily on solutions for the food, dairy, feed and grain industries, you will transform customer requirements into technically robust and commercially competitive process solutions.

Working closely with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders, you will perform process calculations, size equipment, define system configurations and contribute to the development of tailored solutions that balance technical performance, cost efficiency and customer needs.

Your responsibilities will include

• Develop process solutions based on customer requirements and application data, identifying and solving technical issues in the process design

• Perform process calculations and system sizing for complete process installations

• Prepare and review process documentation

• Collaborate with suppliers regarding technical specifications and equipment selection

• Prepare technical proposals and quotations

• Contribute to the development and standardization of engineering tools, methods and solutions

• Work closely with R&D and the product management team to develop competitive solutions

• Support continuous improvement of process design standards and engineering practices

• Participate in occasional international travel for customer and technical meetings (approx. 20 days per year)

Your profile

We imagine you have a strong engineering background and experience developing process systems or technical solutions within industrial environments.

You likely bring:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree within Process Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Energy Engineering or a related discipline

• Experience within process engineering, system design or industrial solution development, with the ability to independently drive technical tasks

• Skilled in process calculations, equipment sizing and can read PFD and P&ID drawings

• Experience in preparing technical proposals, quotations or engineering project documentation is an advantage

• Experience from the food and dairy industry will be considered an advantage

• Professional proficiency in English. An additional language will be considered an advantage

As a person, you are analytical, solution-oriented and motivated by solving complex technical challenges. You work in a structured manner, take ownership of your tasks and enjoy collaborating across technical and commercial disciplines.

Why join Simatek?

You will join an entrepreneurial organization where the distance from idea to implementation is short, allowing you to make a tangible impact.

The role offers:

• Flexible working conditions including the possibility of working from home, up to two days per week by agreement

• Attractive compensation package including pension scheme, health insurance and performance bonus

• An active social environment and employee association arranging events throughout the year

Interested?

Send your application and CV via the application button. We look forward to hearing from you.

For more information, you are very welcome to contact Senior Business Consultant Erik Bernskov at erik.bernskov@actief-hartmanns.dk or by phone at +45 41 21 13 29. All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

Actief Hartmanns manages the entire recruitment process on behalf of Simatek A/S, and all contact regarding the position should therefore be directed to us. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of age, gender, disability, ethnic background, religion or nationality.

Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the recruitment process once the right candidate has been identified.

**THE OPPORTUNITY

**Ready to shape how Boozt grows and develops one of its most important departments across markets?

We are looking for a Marketing Manager for a maternity cover of approximately 13 months to lead the marketing agenda for our Kids department.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of customer insight, commercial priorities, Buying strategy and marketing. You will help define what Kids should stand for at Boozt, identify the categories, themes and moments we should prioritise, and translate these into a strong marketing plan across our markets.

You will work closely with Buying & Merchandising, our market and campaign teams and specialist functions across CRM, E-commerce, Media, Brand & Creative and Social to ensure that the right Kids priorities are brought to market in the right way.

This is a role for a commercially strong marketer who combines strategic thinking with a practical understanding of what it takes to create relevant, high-performing marketing in a fast-moving e-commerce environment.

**What You Will Do

**You will be responsible for developing and continuously strengthening the Kids marketing agenda.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Own the Kids marketing plan and positioning, defining the key categories, themes and customer opportunities to prioritise throughout the year, based on commercial performance, customer insight, seasonality and Buying strategy.

• Work closely with Buying & Merchandising to ensure that assortment priorities, strategic category opportunities, launches and relevant brand initiatives are translated into strong customer-facing marketing opportunities.

• Drive the Kids agenda across markets and campaigns, adapting priorities with the market/GTM team to reflect local customer needs, commercial potential and seasonality, while ensuring Kids is represented in larger Boozt campaigns with the right categories and propositions.

• Set the direction for customer-facing marketing partnering with Campaign Leads, E-commerce, CRM, Media, Brand & Creative and Social to translate Kids priorities into relevant campaigns, onsite experiences, customer journeys and content. You own the commercial direction and priorities, while specialist teams drive execution.

• Own performance and continuous improvement, using data and customer insights to measure impact, identify growth opportunities, challenge existing plans and strengthen the Kids marketing agenda.

**How The Role Works

**You will be the **marketing owner for the Kids department.

****This Means You Are Accountable For Defining

**

• what Marketing should prioritise within Kids

• why those priorities matter

• when they are relevant

• which markets they matter in

• what commercial or customer outcome they should deliver

**YOUR PROFILE

**We are looking for someone who combines strong commercial judgement with a genuine understanding of customers, categories and marketing. You know how to turn insights into clear priorities and bring people together around opportunities that drive business results.

**We Imagine That You Bring

**

• At least 5 years of experience in e-commerce, retail or consumer marketing, preferably within fashion, kidswear or a related category.

• Strong commercial understanding, connecting customer behaviour, category performance, seasonality and marketing opportunities.

• Experience developing marketing strategies and plans, translating business and customer insights into clear priorities and actionable initiatives.

• Strong analytical skills and confidence working with performance data. Experience with Qlik Sense, Google Analytics or similar tools is an advantage.

• Strong stakeholder-management skills and the ability to challenge constructively, make clear recommendations and prioritise across Buying, commercial, creative and digital teams.

• Strong marketing judgement, a high quality bar and a structured, proactive approach, combined with the flexibility to navigate a fast-moving environment.

• Fluency in English, our company language.

**WHY JOIN NOW?

**Boozt is evolving how Marketing works across markets, departments and specialist teams.

This role therefore offers the opportunity not only to lead the Kids marketing agenda during the maternity-cover period, but also to contribute to how we build a stronger, more commercially focused and more market-relevant marketing organisation going forward.

**Apply today – we’re excited to learn more about you!

_Only applications submitted in English will be considered.

_Important: Applicants must have the legal right to work in Denmark at the time of employment. Please note that this position does not include visa sponsorship or relocation support.

We review applications on an ongoing basis. You can read more about the process under **Recruitment.

****BOOZT PERKS

**

• Great personal and internal career development opportunities

• A culture built on our values of trust, freedom, and responsibility

• Driven and passionate international colleagues

• A generous employee discount

• Healthy and delicious breakfast and lunch, top-quality coffee, and fresh fruit available all day

• In-house gym, onsite masseuse, and medical doctor

• An amazing HQ in central Copenhagen – the iconic, energy-efficient Krystallen building, recognized for its architectural design and sustainability. Enjoy breathtaking city views and much more!

jobs.occupation: Data Science Student in Strategy & Transformation
jobs.description:
**Data Science Student in Strategy & Transformation

Who We Are

**NNIT is a niche specialist in IT for life sciences and highly regulated industries. We help pharma, biotech and medtech companies across Europe, the US and Asia, as well as public sector and regulated customers in Denmark, solve their most complex challenges where technology, regulation and business critical processes meet.

We are in the middle of a fundamental transformation. Our strategy, OneNNIT 2030, sets out how we will sharpen our position as a niche specialist, reshape our portfolio into a focused set of value pathways that take customers from advisory through implementation to managed services, bring our US and European organisations together as one, and become a genuinely AI-driven company.

The Strategy & Transformation Office leads that journey. It reports directly to our CEO, owns NNIT's strategy cycle, runs the transformation programme and builds the capabilities that will carry the momentum through to 2030. We are now building the team, and we are looking for a Data Science Student who wants to work at the heart of it.

**What You Will Do

**You will be part of the analytical engine in the Strategy & Transformation Office. Every major decision in our transformation needs a solid fact base, and every initiative needs to show that it delivers. You will help build both, and your work will land directly with our CEO and Executive Management.

You are comfortable with code and data, and just as interested in what the numbers mean for the business. You are AI savvy, and you are curious about the bigger picture of how AI transforms organisations, ways of working and business models.

**Typical tasks include

**▪ Building the fact base behind OneNNIT 2030, from portfolio and revenue analysis to customer, market and capability data

▪ Designing and maintaining the KPIs, dashboards and benefit tracking that show Executive Management and the Board how the transformation is progressing

▪ Modelling revenue, margin and demand across offerings and geographies as we consolidate our portfolio into value pathways

▪ Combining data from finance, sales, delivery and HR systems into analyses that inform strategic decisions

▪ Identifying, sizing and prioritising AI use cases across our offerings, delivery model and internal processes, and tracking AI adoption across NNIT

▪ Building prototypes and analytical tools in Python, SQL or Power BI, and using generative AI to work faster and smarter

▪ Turning analysis into clear insights and material for workshops, leadership meetings and strategy sessions

**What You Will Bring

****We imagine that you

**▪ Are preferably in the third year of your Bachelor's degree, or in the first year of your Master’s degree, for example in Business ▪ Administration and Data Science or Digital Management at Copenhagen Business School

▪ Have a strong interest in data science, AI, strategy and business transformation

▪ Are curious about how data and AI change decisions, organisations and value creation

▪ Are analytical and structured, and able to turn complex data into clear insights that non-specialists can act on

▪ Have hands-on experience with Python and SQL, and with Power BI or a similar tool, alongside strong Excel and PowerPoint skills

▪ Communicate clearly and professionally in Danish and English, both written and spoken

▪ Take initiative, have a strong eye for quality, handle confidential information with discretion and enjoy working with senior stakeholders

**What We Offer

**You will join the Strategy & Transformation Office, which reports directly to the CEO, and work closely with the Head of Strategy & Transformation. You will have a front-row seat as NNIT redefines its strategy, organisation and portfolio, and you will work alongside Executive Management, senior leaders across Europe, the US and Asia, and our external advisors.

You will get real responsibility from day one, high exposure to senior leadership and the flexibility to balance work with your studies. Few student jobs offer a closer view of how strategy and transformation are done in practice.

**Practical Information

**The role is 15 to 20 hours per week, with flexibility around exams.

Please upload your CV and cover letter in English. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply soon.

**About NNIT

**NNIT is a publicly listed company that specializes in IT solutions to life sciences internationally, and to the public and enterprise sectors in Denmark. We focus on high complexity industries and thrive in environments where regulatory demands and complexity are high. We advise on and build sustainable digital solutions that work for the patients, citizens, employees, end users or customers.

jobs.occupation: Student employee for Commercial Asset Management, Italy
jobs.description:
You’ll gain hands-on experience and insight into the energy markets that go beyond what you learn in the classroom. Along the way, you’ll help create solutions that enable our customers to grow their businesses.

Here’s what the job entails

As our new Junior Commercial Asset Manager, you will support our Commercial Asset Management and Origination teams, with a particular focus on Italian customers within renewables assets. You will contribute to a variety of commercial activities while gaining hands-on experience with the European energy markets. A key part of the role is also to engage with stakeholders, build relations and navigate across the entire organisation.

Furthermore, your responsibilities include:

• handling contract management and preparing tender and sales material

• joining customer meetings and contributing to solutions that support customer growth

• supporting planning, execution, and participation of commercial events, conferences and fairs

• collaborating closely with middle and back-office teams

• driving and participating in internal projects

The position is based in Copenhagen, alternatively Aarhus.

Meet your team

You will join our Commercial Asset Management team, dedicated to optimising Danske Commodities’ customer-related activities in Europe. The team collaborates closely with our Origination sales team to grow our customer business by for instance drafting contracts, managing tender processes and driving business development.

We share a deep understanding of energy markets and what our customers need. We keep an informal tone, and we believe teamwork is key to success. As a diverse team of market specialists across various European offices, nationalities and backgrounds, we bring together different perspectives to create real impact.

But enough about us… over to you!

As you will work on a variety of tasks and collaborate with different people across the organisation, we imagine that you are curious, structured and comfortable taking responsibility for your work. You enjoy working with others and find energy in supporting customers and colleagues.

Furthermore, we imagine that you:

• are enrolled in a relevant education within Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Energy Economics or similar

• are curious about energy markets and motivated to learn more

• can work approximately 15-20 hours a week

• are proficient in Italian and English – both written and spoken. If you speak any additional languages, we would love to hear about them

Please note that prior knowledge of the energy sector is not required for this role.

We’ll take good care of you

At Danske Commodities, we take great care of our people. Joining us means you’ll get a lot of great perks – including social events, cultural experiences, tasty food and benefits to better your health, your life and your future.

Here are some of the benefits we offer our employees:

Shape your development tailored growth plans, 100+ DC University courses & Harvard Learning access

100+ yearly events from office parties to DC Sports events, CS:GO team, student network & more

Global career paths as part of our parent company, Equinor’s 20,000-strong international network

Flexible work life to fit with your studies

Unlimited paid child’s sick days because family comes first

Free tickets & discounts culture, family fun, hotels, restaurants & more

Organic meals light breakfast, lunch, snacks, dinner & take-away

…. and much more

We're an energy trading and optimisation company that works at the intersection of technology and energy economics. Our disciplined and scalable trading strategies are designed to be competitive in volatile markets and create value for our partners.

About the role

Sparrow Quantum is growing fast, and the people we hire in the coming years will shape what the company becomes. We are looking for a talent acquisition and HR partner who can lead our recruiting efforts and grow with our HR function.

Recruitment is the core of the role. You will own hiring from the first conversation with a hiring manager to the signed contract, across scientific, engineering, and commercial roles, in Denmark and internationally. Some travel might be expected.

Initially, your focus will be on talent acquisition. Once core hiring is under way, you will gradually take on more of the employee lifecycle, from onboarding to offboarding, with support from external HR partners. HR at Sparrow Quantum is a function under development, and the role will grow with it, with a path towards Head of HR.

Responsibilities

Core responsibilities - leading talent acquisition

• 
Own the full recruitment process, from role definition with hiring managers to offer and contract-signing

• 
Source and attract candidates for specialist roles in quantum photonics, engineering, and production, as well as business functions

• 
Work with our Communications & Marketing Manager on building our employer brand and a talent pipeline, including attending job fairs at local and international universities

• 
Own our applicant tracking system, and report on hiring progress and time to hire

• 
Manage recruitment agencies, where they add value

• 
Coordinate with our Office & Admin Manager on work permits and relocation for international hires

• 
Source scientists and engineers through academic networks, conferences, and research groups, and run technical screening together with hiring managers

Career growth - HR across the employee life cycle

• 
Design onboarding that integrates new colleagues quickly

• 
Own retention initiatives, including employee surveys and follow-up on the results

• 
Support on building performance reviews and development paths for our employees

• 
Run offboarding, including exit interviews and knowledge handover

• 
Be the first point of contact for employees and managers on HR questions

• 
Keep contracts, policies, and HR documentation compliant with Danish employment law

Building the function

• 
Prioritize which HR processes, policies, and tools to build first as the company scales

• 
Manage our collaboration with external HR partners

• 
Advise management on workforce planning, organization ,and compensation, together with the VP of Finance

Who we are looking for

You are an HR professional with a strong recruitment profile, and you want to grow into or take on a broader HR role. If you don't already have experience within quantum or deep tech, then you should have a keen eye and an ability to learn quickly, so you can help find the best candidates for our team. And you should be excited by the prospect of being part of a company that's on a growth journey, where each day is often different from the next.

Must-haves

• 
2 to 6 years of experience in HR, with a clear focus on recruitment

• 
A clear wish to broaden into HR, from onboarding and development to offboarding

• 
Working knowledge of Danish employment law and practice

• 
A structured way of working and sound judgement with confidential matters

• 
Fluent written and spoken English

Nice-to-haves

• 
Experience within deep tech, research, or tech, and at a start-up or scale-up

• 
Experience recruiting scientists or engineers, ideally internationally

• 
Experience working with Teamtailor and its HRIS Aboard

• 
Experience setting up HR processes or an applicant tracking system from scratch

• 
Experience with work permits for non-EU hires

• 
Experience working with external HR or recruitment partners

What we offer

• 
Working in a highly motivated team of passionate people at the forefront of photonic quantum technology

• 
Competitive salary + company paid pension

• 
Private health insurance

• 
Flexible working hours and ability to work remotely temporarily

• 
Six weeks of paid vacation and paid family leave

• 
Lunch subsidized by the company

• 
DSB Business Card

• 
Company phone and company credit card

• 
Opportunities to attend conferences and workshops

• 
Steep learning curve in a supportive environment within a rapidly expanding industry

Why Sparrow

• 
Passionate International Team – Join a group of committed professionals where your perspective and initiative have a direct impact

• 
Cutting-Edge Projects and Collaborators – Work with world-leading researchers and innovators to shape quantum technology's future

• 
Growth and Learning – Be part of a supportive culture with mentoring, knowledge sharing, and opportunities to evolve your role

• 
Career Progression – Grow into project leadership, operations, or funding strategy based on your strengths

• 
Inclusive Culture – We value diversity and prioritize employee well-being and flexibility

How to apply

Scroll down to submit your CV and a short cover letter in English.

We review applications as they arrive and may close the position early, so apply soon. The final deadline is December 1, 2026. For questions about the role, contact Andreas Olesen ao@sparrowquantum.com .

We are committed to a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace and welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities.

About Sparrow Quantum

Sparrow Quantum is a Danish quantum technology company advancing light-matter interfaces for quantum technologies and is widely recognized as a leader in single-photon sources.

Our first product is an on-chip single-photon source that delivers more than 20 million high-quality single photons per second into an optical fiber, used by customers for applications such as multi-photon quantum simulation and quantum key distribution.

The patented technology builds on more than two decades of research by founder Peter Lodahl and the Hy-Q Center of Excellence at the Niels Bohr Institute in Copenhagen. Learn more at www.sparrowquantum.com.

Sparrow Quantum is seeking a student assistant with a data science background to support our business functions with automation and data management

• 
Type: Part-time student position

• 
Hours: 10 to 15 hours per week, planned around your studies

• 
Compensation: Hourly wage according to qualifications

• 
Location: Frederiksberg

• 
Start date: February 1 (flexible)

• 
Reports to: VP of Finance

About the role

Do you want to apply your data science skills to real business problems in a deep-tech scale-up?

As Sparrow Quantum grows, so does the data behind the business: customer and supplier records, orders, finance figures, and hiring data spread across spreadsheets and systems. We are looking for a student assistant to bring order to that data and automate the work around it, in close collaboration with finance, operations, HR, sales, and marketing.

To be clear about the scope: this is applied data work for business functions, not machine learning research. Your hours will be split evenly between data management and automation on one side, and business support across the company on the other.

Responsibilities

Data management

• 
Clean and maintain business data across finance, operations, HR, sales, and marketing

• 
Support on developing data flows between our systems, so the same data is not entered twice

• 
Maintain data quality checks, naming conventions and documentation, and keep them up to date

• 
Support maintaining dashboards and reports that give management and teams an up-to-date view of key figures, in tools such as Power BI and Excel

Automation

• 
Support on mapping recurring manual processes and propose which to automate first

• 
Help build and maintain automations in Python or other tools, and with tools such as Microsoft 365

• 
Use AI tools, including large language models, to speed up data handling and reporting, within our rules for confidential information

• 
Document what you build so colleagues can run it when you are not there

Business support (about half your time)

• 
Support finance, operations, and HR with day-to-day tasks such as documentation, purchasing, invoicing, and supplier contact

• 
Take on ad hoc analyses and small projects wherever the business needs a hand

Who we are looking for

You enjoy turning messy data into something people can rely on, and you would rather fix a process than repeat it. You are curious about how a company works across functions, and you can explain your work to colleagues without a technical background.

You have

• 
Enrollment in a bachelor's or master's program in data science or a related field, with at least 1.5 years of study left

• 
Experience with Python for data work, including pandas or similar libraries

• 
Knowledge of SQL and relational data

• 
Experience cleaning, structuring, and visualizing real-world data

• 
Hands-on experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot, and a realistic view of where they fail

• 
A structured, reliable way of working

• 
Discretion with confidential information

• 
Fluent written and spoken English

Nice to have

• 
Experience with Power BI, Power Automate or other Microsoft 365 tools

• 
Experience with APIs or simple data pipelines

• 
Understanding basic accounting and financial data

• 
Curiosity about quantum technology. No physics background required

What we offer

• 
Flexibility: hours planned around lectures and exams, with lighter weeks when your studies require it

• 
Visible impact: the data flows, dashboards and automations you build will be used by the team every day, not filed away

• 
A view of the whole company: insight into how a deep-tech scale-up works across R&D, production, sales and finance

• 
A supportive team: colleagues who share knowledge freely and expect you to ask questions

• 
Shaping your role: it is a new role, and you can help shape it

How to apply

Scroll down to submit your CV and a short cover letter in English. In the letter, describe one data or automation project you have worked on: the problem, what you built and what it changed. A GitHub link or a few sentences is enough.

We review applications as they arrive and may close the position early, so apply soon. The final deadline is 1st December. For questions about the role, contact Anna Sogli, agd@sparrowquantum.com.

We are committed to a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace and welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities.

About Sparrow Quantum

Sparrow Quantum is a Danish quantum technology company advancing light-matter interfaces for quantum technologies and is widely recognized as a leader in single-photon sources.

Our first product is an on-chip single-photon source that delivers more than 20 million high-quality single photons per second into an optical fiber, used by customers for applications such as multi-photon quantum simulation and quantum key distribution.

The patented technology builds on more than two decades of research by founder Peter Lodahl and the Hy-Q Center of Excellence at the Niels Bohr Institute in Copenhagen. Learn more at www.sparrowquantum.com.

At KMD, we build digital solutions used by millions of people around the world. These solutions are the digital foundations of our most important institutions, from governments and public services to financial industries and private companies. We believe that the future is what you make it. So a career at KMD is a career with purpose and freedom. One where you’ll have a direct hand in improving the lives of people, while being empowered with the resources and autonomy to shape the course of your own professional journey.

jobs.occupation: Associate Partner and Competence Team Lead, Operational Transformation, Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Associate Partner and Competence Team Lead, Operational Transformation, Copenhagen

Are you motivated by the opportunity to deepen your leadership, commercial and advisory impact while contributing to sustainable growth in the operational transformation area? As Associate Partner and Competence Team Lead for Valcon’s Operational Transformation team, you will play a key role in developing our people, strengthening client partnerships and evolving our capabilities. And you will be instrumental in growing the area considerably in the future matching Valcon’s growth ambitions.

Role and profile

The job is located at the intersection between client delivery, team leadership, commercial work and service offering development.

You will lead a team of approximately 12 consultants and help shape the continued development of our Operational Transformation offerings, focused on Process Redesign and Process Automation, including agentic automation. You are expected to support the further integration of AI, data and technological capabilities into the services based on a clear understanding of our clients’ business needs and strategic ambitions. The ideal candidate brings deep experience and insight from both operations’ excellence and business process redesign as well as technology-driven business change and automation.

You will also act as a trusted advisor to clients, and contribute to Valcon’s growth by being commercial active, building trusted client relationships and lead projects that deliver sustainable results.

To thrive in this role, you have demonstrated experience in these four competence areas:

• Team leadership: Guide, inspire and develop a talented team of consultants, fostering an inclusive environment where people can thrive, collaborate effectively and deliver meaningful results together

• Commercial growth: Strengthen Valcon’s position as a trusted advisor by building long-term client partnerships and creating sustainable growth opportunities together with clients

• Client engagement: Manage and deliver complex projects with high-quality standards from initial mobilization to final delivery and further expansions

• Service development leadership: Develop internal capabilities and strengthen methodologies with AI, data, and technology as key enablers of business transformation

The role offers a high degree of autonomy and responsibility. The ability to balance time between all four areas is key, as they are equally important for success in this role.

In addition, you should embody these skills:

• People skills: Build and nurture existing relationships and teams through empathy, engagement and effective communication with clear direction

• Business and digital acumen: Think analytically and strategically with a pragmatic approach to execution. View AI, data and digital technology as integral elements of modern business development

• Subject-matter-expertise: Business process redesign, improvement and automation

• Education: Speak and write English fluently and professionally, with Danish being a plus. Completed relevant higher education or equivalent professional experience. Further education is a plus

Organisation and reporting

You will be the direct people manager of the Operational Transformation team of consultants (excluding Associate Partners and Partners) or managing their people managers. The role reports to a Partner from either one of our Commercial Sectors or our Head of Consulting.

Location and travel

The role is based at Valcon’s offices in central Copenhagen or Århus, Denmark. You can expect travel in connection with client meetings and project work, primarily within the Nordic region.

About Valcon

We are a European powerhouse in AI and data-driven business transformation, bringing this to life by integrating management consulting with data and digital technology capabilities.

We ensure companies are in their best possible shape – fit for the future. We spot opportunities and help bring them to life. We are thorough, fast and collaborative in everything we do. From the boardroom to the shop floor. From strategy to operations.

We are a no-nonsense consultancy with curious individuals who are driven by creating value together with clients. We have an informal culture and a flat hierarchy with offices in Denmark, Sweden, the Netherlands, the UK, Germany, Croatia and Serbia.

Career opportunities

Valcon is in a significant growth phase supported by acquisitions and capital investment from Rivean Capital and Waterland Private Equity. This supports our ambitious expansion plans – both geographically and in terms of capabilities – with a particular focus on the Nordics and the DACH (German-speaking) region. Therefore, you will have a unique opportunity to help shape the company’s development and gain strategic influence over its future direction.

The role provides internal career development opportunities toward broader leadership roles within the capability or across the broader organisation. With Valcon’s international footprint and focus on complex transformation projects in the business and technological space, you will gain access to:

• A broad network of colleagues and clients across Europe

• Strategically significant and high-complexity projects

• Opportunities to work with cutting-edge technology, including AI, data and digital technologies

Application

If this role sounds like a good match, we warmly encourage you to apply and share how your experience, strengths and perspective could contribute to the team. Deadline for applications is Monday December 7, but we do review applications on an ongoing basis.

**Minimum qualifications:

**

• Bachelor's degree in Network Engineering or Telecom Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 3 years of experience fiber types and their application, physical fiber characteristics, and standard testing tools (e.g., Optical Spectrum Analyzer (OSA), Bit Error Rate Tester (BERT), Optical Time Domain Reflectometer (OTDR)).

• Experience in telecommunications, carrier class optical network infrastructure, transmission systems, layer2/3 routers, and data services.

**Preferred qualifications:

**

• Experience with managing or directing field operation technicians, engineers, contractors or vendors in a Telco working environment.

• Experience in developing and implementing automation solutions for network deployment or similar processes.

• Experience with process improvement or process engineering methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma).

• Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, lead technical projects, prioritize and manage project timelines.

• Ability to travel up to 50% as necessary.

• Strong investigative and problem-solving skills, with a focus on data-driven decision-making.

About the jobAs a Network Implementation Engineer, you will be the initial point of our efforts to execute deployment, maintenance, and operations of private data networks worldwide. You will work with Technical Program Managers, Network Engineers, Design and Infrastructure Engineers, Field Engineers within Google, as well as construction and telecommunications vendors and contractors, all to position your team and organization for success.

You will facilitate faster, better, and more efficient, positive outcomes for the business and our customers. Your objective will be to build the world’s most reliable, cost-effective and scalable network to support all of our current and future customers and users globally.Google's network provides services to millions of Internet users around the world. Our metros are on the edge of our network where Google connects to its users. The Network Team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. Our team owns the full life-cycle of all space, power, and network assets in all of Google’s data centers and metro points of presence globally. From the foundation, we are involved from site acquisition to construction and are accountable for what space and power is delivered. We're involved in every facet of network delivery from architecture and design to installation, configuration, activation, and commissioning. Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Denmark: kr.800000 - kr.820000 (DKK) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

**Responsibilities

**Learn more about benefits at Google .

• Deliver Google's network reliably and at scale, with a focus on workflow automation and efficiency.

• Drive adaptable and scalable approaches, collaborating with cross-functional teams to optimize network deployment cycle time and operational costs through process improvements.

• Manage an area of responsibility, addressing issues, anticipating needs and escalating as necessary, while identifying automation opportunities to improve efficiency and prevent reoccurring failure modes.

• Maintain accurate network data to drive operational excellence.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

We’re Hiring: Skilled Gardener

Do you love working with plants, getting your hands in the soil and taking responsibility? 🌸🌱

Are you an educated gardener looking to become part of a modern potted plant nursery with a fast-paced working environment, a flat organisational structure and a great team spirit? We are looking to strengthen our team, and we look forward to welcoming a new colleague to our team.

At Gartneriet Møllerhøj it’s not just about growing and caring for plants – it’s about delivering quality in everything we say, do and supply to our large customer base across the Nordic countries. Hydrangeas are at the heart of what we do, but we also transform our greenhouses into a sea of colour with asters, poinsettias and diascia.

Our entire production – from our state-of-the-art greenhouses to our outdoor growing areas – is located at one site. This means short lines of communication and an active working day where teamwork is key and things move quickly.

Who are you?

You are passionate about horticulture and take pride in your professional skills. You are the kind of person who arrives at work in the morning motivated and ready to make a difference – both for the plants and your colleagues.

• 
You are an educated gardener and hold a spraying certificate.

• 
You speak Danish or English – or both.

• 
You are reliable and dependable – someone we can count on.

• 
You hold a category B driving licence (car).

• 
You are committed to giving your best, both when it comes to the plants and contributing to a positive working environment.

What do we offer?

We promise that you won't just be another employee. We will welcome you with our new onboarding programme, ensuring you receive the best possible training and feel confident and comfortable in your new role.

• 
Responsibilities: Together with the gardening team, you will handle watering, spraying, biological plant protection, fertilisation and various registration tasks.

• 
Great colleagues: An informal workplace, a flat structure and a strong team spirit, with social events throughout the year.

• 
Attractive conditions: Salary based on qualifications, pension scheme and health insurance.

Working hours:

Monday: 06:30–15:00

Tuesday: 06:30–15:00

Wednesday: 06:30–13:45

Thursday: 06:30–14:45

Friday: 06:30–14:45

The position is 37 hours per week. During the busy spring season, we put in some extra hours, with a few weeks reaching 45 hours. Weekend duties are shared among the team, and as a general rule, you can expect to work approximately every third or fourth weekend.

Could you be the person we're looking for?

If you would like to help strengthen our team and play a part in maintaining our high standards of quality, we would love to hear from you!

We are looking for someone to start as soon as possible, and interviews will be held on an ongoing basis. So don't hesitate to send your CV and a few words about yourself to: maria@50008.dk
